description: Defines the interface for source line resolution in the Google Breakpad project, including methods for loading modules, retrieving source line info, and handling stack frame data.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface class for resolving source line information from memory addresses.

methods.name: LoadModule
methods.description: Adds a module to the resolver, returning true on success.

methods.name: LoadModuleUsingMapBuffer
methods.description: Loads a module using a pre-read map buffer.

methods.name: LoadModuleUsingMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Loads a module using a memory buffer containing symbol data.

methods.name: ShouldDeleteMemoryBufferAfterLoadModule
methods.description: Indicates whether the memory buffer should be deleted after loading.

methods.name: UnloadModule
methods.description: Unloads a specified module from the resolver.

methods.name: HasModule
methods.description: Checks if a module has been loaded.

methods.name: IsModuleCorrupt
methods.description: Checks if a loaded module is corrupt.

methods.name: FillSourceLineInfo
methods.description: Fills in source line information for a stack frame.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves Windows-specific frame info if available.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CFI (Call Frame Information) frame info if available.
